verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (date card, headphones, headline with the RSVP button below it), but the date card is so small that 'NOV' and the time can't be read, the 'Listening session' eyebrow and the body copy are tiny, and the body copy is wedged next to the button. B has the stronger headline and puts the CTA at the far right, but the body copy is squeezed into a narrow, many-line, unreadable column, and the eyebrow and tiny date card float away from the headline as scattered pieces, which looks broken.
